criterion: Build reproducible offline training jobs from timestamped, versioned, matured outcomes; the training manifest hashes code, feature schema, dataset and seed.
test_result: 10 learned-model and temporal-split tests passed; Ruff and targeted mypy passed; source and strategy-variant inventories passed (618 Python files).
evidence_scope: Synthetic learned-model panels and timestamps. No real market dataset, financial outcome provenance, profitability, or forward model quality is claimed.
operational_limits: Rows with unknown or future maturity, incomplete values, unversioned datasets, or naive timestamps cannot enter fitting.
The model loader and cache verifier reject artifacts without a matching offline job manifest.
PE-0172 checks training-time feature availability/revisions; PE-0175 extends availability contracts to inference and batch schemas.
